title: New Quantity per 30 Days for a Dose Change: Decision Table (Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit)
content:
**Decision rule.** For a dose-change override under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit, the new quantity per 30 days depends on the drug's coverage review under the member's Utilization Management Program:

- when a quantity-limit approval for the drug is in force and took effect after the date of the fill being re-dosed, it is that approval's approved quantity per 30 days;
- when instead a quantity-limit exception case for the drug opened after that date is still awaiting decision, it is the quantity per 30 days that case requests;
- otherwise it is the quantity per 30 days of the fill being re-dosed.

**Terms.** The approval looked at is the drug's most recent quantity-limit approval; it is in force when its effective date is today or earlier and its expiration date is today or later. A quantity-limit exception case is awaiting decision when it has been opened and not approved, denied or withdrawn; the case looked at is the most recently opened one. The quantity per 30 days of a fill is its quantity multiplied by 30 and divided by its days supply. The date of the fill being re-dosed is its date of service or, for a home delivery shipment, its shipment date.

## Decision table

| Quantity-limit approval in force, effective after the fill's date | Quantity-limit exception case opened after the fill's date and awaiting decision | New quantity per 30 days |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Either | The approval's approved quantity per 30 days |
| No | Yes | The case's requested quantity per 30 days |
| No | No | The fill's own quantity per 30 days |

## Examples (hypothetical records)

- Fill dated May 1: 60 tablets for 30 days, so 60 per 30 days. Approval in force since May 15 at 90 per 30 days: the new quantity is 90.
- Same fill; the approval took effect April 20, before the fill: the approval does not count. A case opened May 12 requesting 120 per 30 days is awaiting decision: the new quantity is 120.
- Same fill; no approval after the fill and no case awaiting decision: 60.
